semaglutide.mechanism_of_action: GLP-1 receptor agonist — stimulates insulin secretion and suppresses glucagon in a glucose-dependent manner; slows gastric emptying.

metformin.mechanism_of_action: AMPK activator — inhibits mitochondrial complex I, reducing hepatic gluconeogenesis; also activates AMPK pathway.

atorvastatin.mechanism_of_action: HMG-CoA reductase inhibitor — competitively inhibits hepatic cholesterol synthesis; increases LDL receptor expression.
